alternative_explanations: Any gain may come from a favorable grammar ordering rather than a reusable semantic abstraction.
Four input-output examples may admit a shorter semantically equivalent program.
The synthetic corpus may reveal the motif more cleanly than realistic program corpora.
confounds: Program length is supplied to all solvers.
Primitive semantics and DSL are hand-provided, while only the macro is discovered.
Quick uses one seed and cannot establish robustness.
falsification_criteria: Learned-library held-out accuracy is below primitive-only accuracy.
At D=4/6 the learned library reduces cold operations by less than 30 percent or is matched by exact memo.
Discovery plus library state cannot amortize within the preregistered eight-task cell.

outcome_policy.negative: This extractor or corpus construction fails the discriminating transfer test; preserve it and change family or mechanism rather than tune after the result.
outcome_policy.null: Library extraction works mechanically but does not improve end-to-end held-out search enough to prioritize this implementation.
outcome_policy.positive: The minimal induced library shows a local held-out search-compression signal worth multi-seed adversarial replication, not evidence of general intelligence.

predicted_outcome: The learned library will recover the repeated fragment without a motif label, retain exact held-out accuracy, and reduce D=4/6 cold search operations by at least 30 percent versus primitive-only and exact memo; mismatch will not help and oracle bounds the attainable gain.
promotion_criteria: Quick evidence may only justify a screen replication when exact accuracy is preserved, D=4/6 operations fall by at least 30 percent, mismatch does not reproduce the gain, and total discovery cost amortizes within eight held-out tasks.
research_question: Does an automatically extracted repeated program fragment reduce exact held-out synthesis search beyond primitive-only enumeration and exact-query memoization after charging discovery and state?
title: Held-out program search with an induced reusable library
